user.title: Set up HALP!
user.description: Select the Home Assistant Person entity HALP! should analyze. HALP! will not modify the Person entity or any trackers.

classify_person_sources_v2.title: Classify assigned location sources
classify_person_sources_v2.description: Below are the trackers assigned to {person_name}. Classify each source as GPS, BLE, WiFi/router, Other, or Ignore. Ignore excludes the assigned tracker from HALP! analysis and suppresses tracker mismatch warnings for that tracker.

assign_fixed_zones_v2.title: Assign fixed trackers to zones
assign_fixed_zones_v2.description: Assign each BLE and fixed WiFi/router tracker for {person_name} to exactly one active Home Assistant zone. GPS trackers need no zone assignment because they report zones dynamically. For a genuinely mobile WiFi/router source, choose None / Mobile; it will remain visible in diagnostics but will not vote for an absolute geographic zone.

error.at_least_one_classified_source_required: At least one assigned tracker must be classified as GPS, BLE, or WiFi/router.
error.fixed_zone_required: Every BLE tracker must have one active zone. Every WiFi/router tracker must have one active zone or None / Mobile.

abort.already_configured: This Person entity is already configured in HALP!.

init.title: Configure HALP!
init.description: Adjust HALP!'s reliability threshold and source weights.

person.title: Configure HALP! Person
person.description: Confirm the Home Assistant Person entity HALP! should analyze. The next step lets you classify assigned trackers as GPS, BLE, WiFi/router, Other, or Ignore.

classify_person_sources.title: Classify assigned location sources
classify_person_sources.description: Below are the trackers assigned to {person_name}. Classify each source as GPS, BLE, WiFi/router, Other, or Ignore. Ignore excludes the assigned tracker from HALP! analysis and suppresses tracker mismatch warnings for that tracker.

tuning.title: Tune HALP! reliability scoring
tuning.description: Adjust HALP!'s GPS location-transition speedup option, reliability threshold, and source weights. When GPS confirms departure, the same option also prevents old fixed-location evidence from snapping Vetted Location back to a geographically incompatible departed zone. Fresh fixed-source arrivals remain valid. The same weights and thresholds apply in every zone.

data.prioritize_second_gps_not_home: Speed up location transitions: prioritize second matching GPS location update.

assign_fixed_zones.title: Assign fixed trackers to zones
assign_fixed_zones.description: Assign each BLE and fixed WiFi/router tracker for {person_name} to exactly one active Home Assistant zone. Deleted trackers and deleted zones are discarded when this flow is saved. GPS needs no zone assignment. For a genuinely mobile WiFi/router source, choose None / Mobile; it will remain visible in diagnostics but will not vote for an absolute geographic zone.

error.at_least_one_classified_source_required: At least one assigned tracker must be classified as GPS, BLE, or WiFi/router.
error.fixed_zone_required: Every BLE tracker must have one active zone. Every WiFi/router tracker must have one active zone or None / Mobile.
